blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current V202 renders: crouch and sit expose both thighs through the front opening while the hem folds into angular flaps beneath the knees and the side/back skirt hangs behind. Prone tents the skirt above the hips and bunches it underneath. The front-lap geometry does not maintain a continuous hem or coverage in required poses.

Neutral front and three-quarter views show tightly crushed angular facets instead of separated broad pleat channels; the back reads as nearly plain with little visible pleat structure. The jacket torso/waist also has conspicuous crumpled faceting.

Both side silhouettes retain a front/side hem step and tapered tail rather than a smooth continuous hem. Gray patches are visible at both sleeve roots in front view and remain at viewer-right underarm with arms raised; sleeve-to-jacket overlap is uneven.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
